name: Coline
source:
Although fails in her duty to protect the seal that contains the demons. The pure fairy born and raised in heaven finds a new mission by helping Anduke to revive the Path Of Light. Her steadfast loyalty to Anduke is second to none. She also has no fighting power.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071230090604fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/dangel/chara.html]Mink[/url]]
